Package com.helix.profiler.flamegraph

Class AsciiFlameRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.helix.profiler.flamegraph.AsciiFlameRenderer
public class AsciiFlameRenderer extends Object
High-performance Unicode ASCII Flame Graph Renderer.

Translates hierarchical prefix tries (StackFrameNode) into Unicode box-drawing bar layouts (┌, ┐, └, ┘, ─, │, ┬, ┴, ┼). Dynamically adapts bar widths to terminal columns, applies smart text truncation, and renders interactive, theme-safe colors.

Also provides standalone vector SVG and interactive HTML export capabilities.

    • renderToString

      public String renderToString(int totalWidth, int maxDepths, boolean withAnsi)
      Renders a multi-level Unicode box-drawing flame graph to a String. Uses box-drawing characters: ┌, ┐, └, ┘, ─, │, ┬, ┴.
      Parameters:
      totalWidth - Total width in columns (e.g. 80 to 160+)
      maxDepths - Maximum stack depths to render
      withAnsi - Whether to embed 24-bit ANSI colors
      Returns:
      Rendered flame graph string

      public void renderToLanterna(com.googlecode.lanterna.graphics.TextGraphics graphics, int originX, int originY, int width, int height)
      Renders the flame graph directly onto a Lanterna TextGraphics viewport. Guarantees 100% legibility on any terminal theme with explicit foreground & background colors.
      Parameters:
      graphics - Lanterna TextGraphics instance

      originY - Top-left row offset
      width - Available columns
      height - Available rows
